title: Introduce Credential Factory and consolidate SDK stream namespace
author: Ava Moreno
description:
Motivation: We have drift between the Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs in two areas that frequently confuse integrators: credential composition/rotation APIs and stream primitive names. This PR introduces a small, explicit CredentialFactory abstraction across all three SDKs (py/ts/go) to centralize token provider wiring, make prefetch/refresh policies composable, and provide a single upgrade path for future delegated auth features. It also consolidates and renames stream primitive exports under a clearer namespace (PullStreamReader, PushStreamWriter -> PullReader, PushWriter) to improve discoverability and reduce API surface duplication across languages.

Summary of changes: 1) New cross-SDK concept: CredentialFactory. Each SDK exposes a factory constructor that accepts a canonical set of options (provider, prefetchWindowMs, jitterProfile, metricsScope). This is intentionally small to make migration easy. 2) TokenProvider interface clarified and documented; adapters provided for existing token shapes (static API key, rotating refresh-token, platform-delegated credentials). 3) Stream namespace reshuffle: flattened stream exports and added thin aliases for backwards compatibility for one release. 4) Retry preset mapping: the SDKs now share a canonical mapping from server-side retry-profile names to client presets; added adapter hooks to override profile->preset resolution. 5) Tests: added cross-language integration fixtures that exercise a credential rotation scenario with concurrent streams to validate no race during token swap. 6) Docs and examples updated for all three SDKs and we added a migration guide.

Compatibility and migration notes: - We retained old stream names as deprecated aliases that log a single deprecation warning on first import. The aliases will be removed in the next major version. - CredentialFactory is additive; existing TokenProvider implementations can be wrapped with factory.compose() helpers. Migration guide included in sdks/*/MIGRATION.md. - Minor surface change in config shape for session creation: sessionConfig.credential -> sessionConfig.credentialFactory (both accepted for now).

Testing and CI: - Unit tests added/updated in py/ts/go. - New integration matrix in CI exercises: (python client + redwood local runtime), (typescript client + hosted staging), (go client + local runtime). - Flaky integration test in TS (stream-reconnect/test) was quarantined and re-run; the final CI matrix is green.

Why this is incremental: The design intentionally provides thin, language-idiomatic facades while centralizing the mental model (factory + token provider). The goal is to reduce follow-up churn when we add delegated auth (edge proxies) or pre-warmed leases.

Related: ENG-4231 (credential strategy consolidation), ENG-4302 (stream naming ergonomics).
